title: Closed Learning Loop & Adaptive Planning

step0_audit.title: Audit current knowledge flow
step0_audit.root_cause: detectAppMetadata({targetUrl}) at mission start detected NO keywords for localhost URLs → queryKnowledge({}) scored all patterns relevance=0 → 0 patterns returned → empty hints. writeKnowledge at finalization DID work (session had content by then). validateKnowledge/detectKnowledgeConflicts existed but were NOT called in autonomous path.

fixes_applied.description: Added validateKnowledge + detectKnowledgeConflicts calls in finalizeMissionFromSession after writeKnowledge
fixes_applied.result: Validation loop closed — pattern confidence updated based on current mission evidence

fixes_applied.description: Enhanced generateExplorationHints with adaptive Priority Focus Areas
fixes_applied.result: High-confidence patterns (≥2 occurrences) now generate explicit 'Prioritize testing these flows early' guidance

step5_adaptive_planning_architecture.title: Inspect adaptive planning architecture
step5_adaptive_planning_architecture.decision: Existing LLM-driven architecture used. Knowledge is a CONTEXT signal appended to agent prompt via buildMissionPrompt(mission) + knowledgeHints. No second planning engine created.

step6_next_action_adaptation.title: Implement next-action adaptation
step6_next_action_adaptation.mechanism: Priority Focus Areas in generateExplorationHints — high-confidence patterns (≥2 occurrences) generate explicit guidance: 'Prioritize testing these flows early'. Agent adapts testing order based on historical risk.
